lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Dozens of people gathered at a bar in downtown Vancouver on Sunday for a lookalike contest, The Canadian Press reports.
Why the Trump-Xi-Putin summit is bad news for Canada, CityNews Winnipeg reports.
Ukrainian forces deployed seven domestically made sea drones in the operation, which struck the Russian navy corvette in the Mediterranean, according to Zelenskyy.
South Korea must confront K-pop’s ugly side, The Japan Times reports.
Democrats have gained 44 House seats so far, four more than the 40 they picked up in U.S, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
